headline: the R170 unreachability verdict is retracted; with stage A measured and the FA overhead decomposed, 10 s is judged reachable
retraction: R170 assumed the audit cost was irrecoverable (R185 recovered 2.514 s end to end) and that FA had to match GEMM (R189 shows only 36% of GEMM is needed in causal terms; R193 measures 1.89x of theoretical headroom)
fa_verdict: core budget, tile tuning and softmax are all ruled out; the remaining 1.37x requires changing the per-tile cost inside the TIK kernel
decisions_needed: decide the FP32 guard criterion form
machine_use_this_round: R194 sweep only, private copies, original files untouched, lease released
